synopsis: The Comédie-Française is one of France’s most revered arts institutions, and the oldest still-performing theatre company in the world. There is one golden rule: the play is NEVER cancelled. Unfortunately for theatre producer Nina (Pauline Clément), everything is unravelling just three hours before the premiere of her first production – an ambitious retelling of Shakespeare’s Macbeth. Her lead actor is stuck on a train, tensions are exploding, passions flaring, equipment breaking down and egos ar
tmdb_overview: At the Comédie-Française, there is one golden rule: the play is never canceled. Unfortunately for Nina, everything else is—just three hours before the premiere of her first staging. An actor is stuck on a train, tensions explode, equipment breaks down, egos clash, and panic sets in. With no way out and time slipping away, Nina must hold the show together at all costs. Will she make it until the curtain rises?

synopsis: When Russian forces bombed a giant hydroelectric dam on Ukraine's mighty Dnipro River in June 2023, farmland flooded, homes were destroyed…
tmdb_overview: When Russian forces bombed a giant hydroelectric dam on Ukraine’s mighty Dnipro River in June 2023, farmland flooded, homes were destroyed and over 50 people lost their lives. Upriver, as waters drained, ancient ships’ timbers were uncovered on the newly exposed beach. Now, a Ukrainian archaeologist Dmitro Kobaliaa has assembled an international team to recover these remains, to reveal the story of a vast Russian military flotilla sent to conquer land around the Black Sea coast. It’s a battle still raging today. As fighter jets shoot overhead, Dmitro’s discoveries reveal a history of Ukraine before Russian rule, a history the Russians are trying to destroy, but one Dmitro is desperate to preserve.

movie_title_en: American History X + Humpty Dumpty X - PART 1 - Tony Kaye Double Bill
tmdb_overview: Derek Vineyard is paroled after serving 3 years in prison for killing two African-American men. Through his brother, Danny Vineyard's narration, we learn that before going to prison, Derek was a skinhead and the leader of a violent white supremacist gang that committed acts of racial crime throughout L.A. and his actions greatly influenced Danny. Reformed and fresh out of prison, Derek severs contact with the gang and becomes determined to keep Danny from going down the same violent path as he did.

movie_title: Ken Russell's The Devils: The Director's Cut
movie_title_en: Ken Russell's The Devils: The Director's Cut

tmdb_overview: A small-town doctor learns that the population of his community is being replaced by emotionless alien duplicates.
A seductive stranger prowls the streets of Glasgow in search of prey: unsuspecting men who fall under her spell.

Rogue is a "Genetic Infantryman", a genetically-engineered, blue-skinned, manufactured super soldier who, alongside his three comrades, is searching for the Traitor General. His comrades are with him in the form of biochips—onto which a G.I.'s entire personality is downloaded at the time of death for later retrieval—and are named Gunnar (mounted on Rogue's rifle), Bagman (on his backpack) and Helm (on his helmet). Rogue is designed to be immune to almost all known toxins, can submerge in strong acid unaffected, and is able to withstand a vacuum on his bare skin.
A research team in Antarctica is hunted by a shape-shifting alien that assumes the appearance of its victims.
An American newcomer to a prestigious German ballet academy comes to realize that the school is a front for something sinister amid a series of grisly murders.
Two neighbors form a strong bond after both suspect extramarital activities of their spouses. However, they agree to keep their bond platonic so as not to commit similar wrongs.

Jennifer, a gorgeous, seductive cheerleader takes evil to a whole new level after she's possessed by a sinister demon. Now it's up to her best friend to stop Jennifer's reign of terror before it's too late.

movie_title: Funeral Parade presents A Nightmare on Elm Street 2: Freddy's Revenge
movie_title_en: Funeral Parade presents A Nightmare on Elm Street 2: Freddy's Revenge

tmdb_overview: After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, filmmaker John Wilson tries to use the same formula to sell a documentary about concrete.

Jack Torrance accepts a caretaker job at the Overlook Hotel, where he, along with his wife Wendy and their son Danny, must live isolated from the rest of the world for the winter. But they aren't prepared for the madness that lurks within.

Spring 1991: As queer life is under attack in Britain, experimental artist Derek Jarman is turning Edward II into a radical protest film. Told through unseen behind-the-scenes footage, this is a story of the power and cost of queer visibility — then and now.

Rising pop star Mima quits singing to pursue a career as an actress. After she takes up a role on a popular detective show, her handlers and collaborators begin turning up murdered. Harboring feelings of guilt and haunted by visions of her former self, Mima's reality and fantasy meld into a frenzied paranoia.
Fifteen years after murdering his sister on Halloween Night 1963, Michael Myers escapes from a mental hospital and returns to the small town of Haddonfield, Illinois to kill again.
When actress Nikki Grace gets the lead role in a cursed film, her world becomes more and more surreal, blending realities and ideas of infidelity, reincarnation, and supernatural forces.

A charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood.

An octogenarian woman transitions to life in assisted living as she contends with her conflicting relationship to herself and her caregivers amidst her shifting memory, age identity, and desires.

The Dashwood sisters, sensible Elinor and passionate Marianne, learn that their prospects of marriage seem doomed by their family's sudden loss of fortune. After Henry Dashwood dies unexpectedly, his estate must pass on by law to his son. These circumstances leave Mr. Dashwood's wife and daughters without a home and with barely enough money to live on. As Elinor and Marianne struggle to find romantic fulfillment in a society obsessed with financial and social status, they must learn to mix sense with sensibility in their dealings with both money and men.

In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice--launch the most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

At a moment of extraordinary musical achievement, jazz pianist Bill Evans is devastated by the death of his bassist, Scott LaFaro. Retreating from performance, he struggles with grief, addiction and the demands of family life. tmdb_overview: The Dashwood sisters, sensible Elinor and passionate Marianne, learn that their prospects of marriage seem doomed by their family's sudden loss of fortune. movie_title: English National Ballet presents The Sleeping Beauty
movie_title_en: English National Ballet presents The Sleeping Beauty
tmdb_title: English National Ballet presents The Sleeping Beauty
tmdb_original_title: English National Ballet presents The Sleeping Beauty
tmdb_overview: A spellbinding fairytale ballet filmed at London’s Royal Albert Hall.  Sir Kenneth MacMillan’s exquisite ballet will leave you spellbound. A stunning version of one of the world’s favourite fairytales, filmed at London’s Royal Albert Hall.  Featuring First Soloist Anna Nevzorova as Aurora and Davi Ramos as Prince Désiré, the film will whisk you away to an enchanted land and a story of good versus evil. As a baby, Princess Aurora is cursed by the wicked Carabosse (Eireen Evrard). Her godmother, the Lilac Fairy (Anri Sugiura), alters the spell so Aurora will not die, but sleep for 100 years. Only a true love’s kiss can awaken her.  From Aurora’s christening in the palace, to her jubilant wedding, the bewitching tale is brought to life before your eyes through beautiful choreography, sumptuous costumes and stunning new projection sets by Charlotte MacMillan.

tmdb_overview: When amateur historian Catherine Corless begins examining records from a former Mother and Baby Home in Tuam, Co. Galway, she stumbles upon evidence pointing towards a deeply troubling past. Refusing to let the questions go, she embarks on a painstaking investigation, putting her in conflict with the Church, State, and local town. As official resistance mounts, and unsettling discoveries emerge, her determination challenges powerful institutions, exposing a hidden chapter of Ireland's past that many would rather keep hidden.

synopsis: In rural Ireland, amateur historian Catherine Corless begins researching a former institution for unmarried mothers and their children, uncovering a shocking hidden history of loss. ★★★★ - The Times ★★★★ - Guardian
tmdb_overview: When amateur historian Catherine Corless begins examining records from a former Mother and Baby Home in Tuam, Co. Galway, she stumbles upon evidence pointing towards a deeply troubling past. Refusing to let the questions go, she embarks on a painstaking investigation, putting her in conflict with the Church, State, and local town. As official resistance mounts, and unsettling discoveries emerge, her determination challenges powerful institutions, exposing a hidden chapter of Ireland's past that many would rather keep hidden.

synopsis:
500 Miles 
Genre(s): DramaUK/Ireland/Cyprus | 2026 | 112 minsDirector: Morgan MatthewsStars: Loré Adewusi, Dexter Sol Ansell, Eoin Duffy, Clare Dunne, Roman Griffin Davis, Deirdre Monaghan, Bill Nighy, David Ryan, Harleen Sahota, Michael Socha.The 2pm screening on Tuesday 2nd Sept includes descriptive subtitles for those with hearing loss and will be followed by a post-film discussion facilitated by the U3A film club. Everyone is welcome to stay and chat about the film.In this emotional and involving drama, Finn and his brother
Charlie run away from their Yorkshire home to escape the turmoil of their
fractured family life and avoid being separated from each other by their
divorcing parents. Carried along by their own quick wits and the kindness of
strangers, they head to the wild west coast of Ireland, the home of their
beloved but estranged grandfather. This life affirming road movie is cleverly
interwoven with flashbacks of joyful memories and features outstanding performances
from a multi generational cast.
tmdb_overview: A broken family is forced to come together when 16-year-old Finn and his livewire younger brother Charlie run away from trouble at home in England to reach their estranged grandfather on Ireland’s stunning and wild west coast.

synopsis:
Bad Apples 
Genre(s): Comedy/ThrillerUSA/UK | 2025| 100 minsDirector: Jonathan EtzlerStars: Jacob Anderson, Saoirse Ronan, Robert EmmsOur Tuesday 7:30pm screening contains captioned subtitles for those with hearing loss.A blackly comic British thriller,
adapted from the Swedish novel De Oönskare (The Unwanted), and starring
Saoirse Ronan as struggling primary school teacher Maria. After a behavioural
incident on a school trip, she makes an escalating series of bad choices.
Surprised however by the knock-on effects of these decisions, the audience is
ultimately left to decide the fallout from Maria's extreme approach to
classroom management. Featuring some incredibly realistic classroom scenes and
fantastic performances from Oscar nominee Ronan and her students played by
Eddie Waller and Nia Brown, this 2025 festival favourite is a must watch this
term.
tmdb_overview: A struggling primary school teacher begins to make some questionable decisions after one of her students is injured.

synopsis:
Bitter Christmas 
Genre(s): Comedy/DramaSpain | 2025 | 111 mins (Spanish with English Subtitles)Director: Pedro AlmodóvarStars: Bárbara Lennie, Leonardo Sbaraglia, Aitana Sánchez-GijónFrom acclaimed Spanish director Pedro Almodóvar comes Bitter
Christmas. This witty and bittersweet comedy-drama intertwines the
stories of Raúl and Elsa: Raúl is a filmmaker, writing his next screenplay;
Elsa is his imaginary alter ego. As Raúl struggles with writer’s block, he
shamelessly mines the lives of the people closest to him, blurring the
boundaries between art and reality. Almodóvar’s vibrant visual style and
trademark wit create a playful, provocative portrait of love, creativity and
the stories we steal to tell our own.
tmdb_overview: In 2025 Spain, a celebrated film director struggles to write the screenplay for an autofictional film set in 2004 Spain about an unsuccessful movie director turned director of commercials who suffers a panic attack that forces her to take a break by visiting the Canary Islands, where she begins work on a new film.

synopsis:
Cotton Queen 
Genre(s): DramaSUD/GER/FRA/PAL/EGY/QAT/SAU | 2025 | 93 Mins (Arabic with English Subtitles)Director: Suzannah MirghaniStars: Mihad Murtada, Rabha Mohamed Mahmoud, Talaat
Fareed
Mirghani’s
debut feature, a mixture of coming-of-age drama and post-colonial critique,
focusses on teenager Nafisa. Having grown up with her grandmother’s tales of
outsmarting the British, she works in the cotton fields of Sudan with her
friends. She is friendly with a local lad, but her mother has her sights set on
her marriage to Nadir, a British businessman eager to sell his genetically
modified cotton seed to the local farmers. Old practices such as FGM come
face-to-face with the modern world of corporate business and mobile phones in
this beautifully shot, arresting film.
Black History Month screening in conjunction with Croydon
Black History Partnership.
tmdb_overview: In a cotton-farming village in Sudan, teenage Nafisa is raised on heroic tales of battling British colonizers told by her grandmother, the village matriarch Al-Sit. But when a young businessman arrives from abroad with a new development plan and genetically engineered cotton, Nafisa becomes the center of a power play to determine the future of the village. Awakening to her own strength, Nafisa sets out to save the cotton fields – and herself. Neither she nor her community will ever be the same again.

synopsis:
Coyote Vs Acme 
Genre(s): Animation/Comedy/AdventureUSA | 2026 | 101 minsDirector: Dave GreenStars: Will Forte, Lana Condor, John CenaThis film contains flashing images which may affect viewers who are susceptible to photosensitive epilepsy.When loyal Acme
Corporation customer (and avowed enemy of Road Runner) Wile E. Coyote has
finally had enough of the company’s faulty goods, he’s left with one last
course of action: a lawsuit. Securing the services of ambulance-chasing
attorney Kevin Avery (Will Forte), the pair have to take on Acme’s hotshot
lawyer Buddy Crane (John Cena), who happens to be Avery’s former boss. Three
years after being shelved as a tax write-off by its studio, this madcap mix of
animation and live-action is seeing the light of day at long last, presenting
the world of Looney Tunes as you’ve never seen it before.

synopsis:
Dracula (Cert TBC) & Short film
Genre: HorrorUK | 1958 | 83 minsDirector: Terence Fisher
Stars: Peter Cushing, Christopher Lee, Michael Gough

A landmark in English Gothic horror, Dracula made
Christopher Lee an international star, and caused major American distributors
to compete to release Hammer’s films. Elegant but shocking, this first colour
adaptation of Bram Stoker’s novel offered Lee’s physicality and seductive
menace, opposite Peter Cushing’s fearless Van Helsing. Now, following the
discovery of film elements in a Warner Bros. warehouse, a brand new restoration
brings the original uncut version (previously only seen in Japan in 1958) to UK
cinemas for the first time! Halloween screening, with support from Croydon
Council.
Plus
a short (10 mins) exploring the film’s restoration.

tmdb_overview: In late 15th-century Eastern Europe, Prince Vlad II’s bride is brutally murdered. As a result, he renounces God and damns Heaven itself. Cursed with eternal life, Vlad is reborn as Dracula, an immortal warlord who defies fate in a blood-soaked crusade to wrench his lost love back from death.

movie_title_en: ENGLISH NATIONAL BALLET PRESENTS THE SLEEPING BEAUTY
synopsis:
English Nation Ballet Presents Sleeping Beauty 
Genre: PerformanceUK | 2026 | 160 minsDirectors: Ross MacGibbon, Kenneth MacMillan
This classic fairytale ballet with a famous Tchaikovsky
score, is choreographed by Sir Kenneth MacMillan and filmed from a limited run
at The Royal Albert Hall. As a baby, Princess Aurora is cursed by the wicked
Carabosse: on her 16th birthday, she will prick her finger and die. Her
godmother the Lilac Fairy alters the spell so Aurora will not die, but sleep
for 100 years. Only a true love’s kiss can break the spell and awaken her. An
exquisite version of one of the world’s favourite stories. 
Tickets £15.
tmdb_title: English National Ballet presents The Sleeping Beauty
tmdb_original_title: English National Ballet presents The Sleeping Beauty
tmdb_overview: A spellbinding fairytale ballet filmed at London’s Royal Albert Hall.  Sir Kenneth MacMillan’s exquisite ballet will leave you spellbound. A stunning version of one of the world’s favourite fairytales, filmed at London’s Royal Albert Hall.  Featuring First Soloist Anna Nevzorova as Aurora and Davi Ramos as Prince Désiré, the film will whisk you away to an enchanted land and a story of good versus evil. As a baby, Princess Aurora is cursed by the wicked Carabosse (Eireen Evrard). Her godmother, the Lilac Fairy (Anri Sugiura), alters the spell so Aurora will not die, but sleep for 100 years. Only a true love’s kiss can awaken her.  From Aurora’s christening in the palace, to her jubilant wedding, the bewitching tale is brought to life before your eyes through beautiful choreography, sumptuous costumes and stunning new projection sets by Charlotte MacMillan.

synopsis:
Michael 
Genres: Biography | Drama | Music2025 | USA | 127 mins Director: Antoine FuquaCast: Jaafar Jackson, Juliano Valdi, Colman Domingo, Jayden Harville
Tracing the early life and meteoric
rise of one of the most influential artists of the 20th century, Michael charts
the journey of Michael Jackson from his beginnings as the precociously talented
lead singer of the Jackson 5 to his emergence as a global superstar during the
era of his landmark Bad tour. Portrayed by his nephew Jaafar Jackson,
the film explores the ambition, creativity and pressures that shaped his
ascent. Blending intimate moments with recreations of iconic performances, it
offers a portrait of the artist behind the phenomenon — capturing both the
brilliance and the drive that defined his early career.
Black History Month
screening in conjunction with Croydon Black History Partnership.
tmdb_overview: The story of Michael Jackson, one of the most influential artists the world has ever known, and his life beyond the music. His journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fueled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world, highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career.

synopsis:
Pressure 
Genre(s): DramaUK/France/USA | 2026 | 100 minsDirector: Anthony Maras Stars: Andrew Scott, Brendan Fraser, Kerry Condon Our Thursday 22nd Oct 2pm screening contains captioned subtitles for those with hearing loss and a post-screening discussion facilitated by the Croydon u3a Film Group. Anyone is welcome to stay behind for a fun chat.Pressure tells the
remarkable untold story behind one of the most important decisions of the
Second World War. In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, Britain’s chief
meteorological officer, Captain James Stagg (Scott), must convince Allied
commanders, including General Eisenhower (Fraser), whether the weather will
allow the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history to proceed.
With the fate of millions hanging in the balance, this is a fascinating look at
the people, decisions and the uncertainty that helped shape the course of
history. Gripping, intelligent and led by a stellar cast.
tmdb_overview: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, and the fate of the free world hanging in the balance, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

synopsis:
The Cycle of Love 
Genre(s): Documentary/Biography/Action/Adventure/Sci-FiUK/India/Sweden/USA| 2025 | 98 minsDirector: Orlando von EinsiedeStars: PK Mahanandia, Anne-Charlotte von Schedvin, Mina
Dale
In 1975, 23-year-old PK Mahanandia
makes a living drawing portraits for tourists in Delhi when he meets Lotta
(Anne-Charlotte von Schedvin), a Swedish student visiting India. Convinced
their meeting is destiny, PK recalls a childhood prophecy that he would marry a
musical woman from a far-off country, born under the sign of the ox. After
spending time together, Lotta returns to Sweden, promising to come back once
her studies are complete. But when she doesn’t return as planned and PK cannot
afford a plane ticket, he sells everything he owns, buys a second-hand bicycle
and sets off on a 6,000-mile journey across continents to find her.



Based on an extraordinary true
story, The Cycle of Love is a heart-warming tale of love, destiny
and the courage to risk everything for the person you love. Blending
documentary interviews with dramatised scenes, it’s an epic journey that we
challenge you not to shed a tear for!
tmdb_overview: Explores the romantic journey of PK Mahanandia, a Delhi street artist who trekked 6,000 miles by bicycle in 1977, venturing across continents to reunite with the woman he loved.

synopsis: John Ford takes on the legend of the O.K. Corral shoot-out in this multilayered, exceptionally well-constructed western, one of the director’s very best films. Henry Fonda cuts an iconic figure as Wyatt Earp, the sturdy lawman who sets about the task of shaping up the disorderly Arizona town of Tombstone, and Victor Mature gives the performance of his career as the boozy, tubercular gambler and gunman Doc Holliday. Though initially at cross-purposes, the pair ultimately team up to confront the violent Clanton gang. Affecting and stunningly photographed, My Darling Clementine is a story of the triumph of civilization over the Wild West from American cinema’s consummate mythmaker.

Their unlikely partnership, Naz’s unorthodox style, cocky persona, and sheer dominance in the ring propelled them to the top of boxing’s elite and unprecedented levels of global superstardom, all in the face of the rampant Islamophobia and racism of ’80s and 90’s Britain.

Through a mixture of animation and video assemblage, Part Three explores a dreamscape world, parallel to our own. A human enters this world through a portal. This new media work includes poetic story-telling told through the narrator that speaks about gender, describing their own relationship to land, medicine and the beings which inhabit these spaces.

tmdb_title: Second Nature: Gender and Sexuality in the Animal World
tmdb_original_title: Second Nature: Gender and Sexuality in the Animal World
tmdb_overview: Did you know that clownfish change sex from male to female? (So if Nemo’s mom had died in real life, his dad could have become his mom!) Did you know that albatross, penguins and swans parent in same sex pairs? Or that bonobos, who are just as closely related to us as chimps, are matriarchal and have same-sex sex every day?!  Narrated by Elliot Page, Second Nature follows trailblazing Evolutionary Biologist Dr. Joan Roughgarden as she meets groundbreaking scientists exploring the 1500+ animal species who engage in same-sex sexual behavior and parenting, change sex, form matriarchies, and more,  debunking myths that females are “inferior” and that being queer is “unnatural.”  SECOND NATURE — everything you didn’t learn in high school biology.

Coming up against a host of obstacles the family ventures through whirling snowstorms, thick oozing mud and dark forests on their ambitious quest. But when Rosie and Rufus become detached from the rest of the party it looks like bear-hunting might not be such fun after all...

Animated film based on the wonderful children's picture book written by Julia Donaldson and illustrated by Axel Scheffler. A magical tale about friendship and family from Magic Light Pictures, the producers of the hugely successful The Gruffalo and The Gruffalo's Child.

tmdb_overview: We're Going on a Bear Hunt follows the intrepid adventures of siblings Stan, Katie, Rosie, Max, the baby and Rufus the dog, who decide one day to go on an adventure in search of bears. But when Rosie and Rufus become detached from the rest of the party it looks like bear-hunting might not be such fun after all...

Corruption, assassination and street rioting surround the story of the award-winning film, Power Trip, which follows an American multi-national trying to solve the electricity crisis in Tbilisi, capital of the former Soviet Republic of Georgia. Set in the summer of 1983, just before the release of The Witches, Giant imagines a tense meeting between Roald Dahl and his American and British publishers as they scramble to contain the fallout from his public denunciation of Israel and defence of the Palestinians in a review of a book on the 1982 Lebanon war. Filmed live onstage at the Harold Pinter Theatre in London's West End in 2025.

Royal Tenenbaum and his wife Etheline had three children and then they separated. All three children are extraordinary --- all geniuses. Virtually all memory of the brilliance of the young Tenenbaums was subsequently erased by two decades of betrayal, failure, and disaster. Most of this was generally considered to be their father's fault. "The Royal Tenenbaums" is the story of the family's sudden, unexpected reunion one recent winter.

tmdb_title: Royal Opera House: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
tmdb_original_title: Royal Opera House: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
tmdb_overview: A full-length ballet created by choreographer Christopher Wheeldon for the Royal Ballet at the Royal Opera House, Covent Garden. The ballet is based on Lewis Carroll's famous story of Alice, an ordinary girl who one summer afternoon falls down a rabbit hole and finds herself on an extraordinary adventure.  The music is by Joby Talbot, with designs by the internationally acclaimed Bob Crowley. Alice is danced by the Royal Ballet's Lauren Cuthbertson, and actor Simon Russell-Beale plays the cameo role of the Duchess.

synopsis: Bertrand Usclat and Martin Darondeau’s hilarious laugh-a-minute comedy is a wonderfully chaotic love letter to theatre.  The Comédie-Française is one of France’s most revered arts institutions, and the oldest still-performing theatre company in the world. tmdb_overview: At the Comédie-Française, there is one golden rule: the play is never canceled. Unfortunately for Nina, everything else is—just three hours before the premiere of her first staging. An actor is stuck on a train, tensions explode, equipment breaks down, egos clash, and panic sets in. With no way out and time slipping away, Nina must hold the show together at all costs. Will she make it until the curtain rises?

In rural Ireland, amateur historian Catherine Corless begins researching a former institution for unmarried mothers and their children, uncovering a shocking hidden history of loss. Based on the true story, and featuring a powerful performance from Monica Dolan, THE LOST CHILDREN OF TUAM is a deeply moving portrait of one woman’s fight for justice.  Starring Monica Dolan, Andrew Bennett, Ian McElhinney
tmdb_overview: When amateur historian Catherine Corless begins examining records from a former Mother and Baby Home in Tuam, Co. Galway, she stumbles upon evidence pointing towards a deeply troubling past. Refusing to let the questions go, she embarks on a painstaking investigation, putting her in conflict with the Church, State, and local town. As official resistance mounts, and unsettling discoveries emerge, her determination challenges powerful institutions, exposing a hidden chapter of Ireland's past that many would rather keep hidden.

movie_title: Barrel Children: The Families Windrush Left Behind + Live Q&A with Nadine White
movie_title_en: Barrel Children: The Families Windrush Left Behind + Live Q&A with Nadine White
synopsis:
Join us on Monday, 12 October, at Everyman King's Cross for a special screening of Barrel Children: The Families Windrush Left Behind, and stay after for a live Q&A with Nadine White - director and executive producer of the film, multi-award-winning journalist, and editor of Black Current News.

A stellar debut film from award-winning journalist Nadine White, Barrel Children: The Families Windrush Left Behind peels back the layered tales of Caribbean youngsters who grew up away from their parents before migrating to join them in Britain.

The story of Windrush has come into painfully sharp focus in recent years, but what is less well-known is the story of the children of these pioneers, whose parents left to rebuild Britain, and whom they only knew of through the ‘barrel' care packages sent back. 

These are the children’s stories of reconciliation and rediscovery within a new world.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. Winner of 8 Tony Awards including Best Musical and the Grammy Award for Best Musical Theatre Album, HADESTOWN: THE MUSICAL is the genre-defying musical blending modern American folk music with New Orleans-inspired jazz to reimagine a sweeping ancient tale of two intertwining love stories: that of young dreamers Orpheus and Eurydice, and King Hades and his wife Persephone.

tmdb_overview: The tragic love of Orpheus and Eurydice is intertwined with the complex relationship of Hades and Persephone. Eurydice, struggling with poverty, is lured to the industrial underworld of Hadestown by Hades, while Orpheus, a struggling musician, ventures down below to bring her back.

Filmed live on stage in London’s West End and featuring the original Broadway stars, HADESTOWN: THE MUSICAL invites audiences on a hell-raising journey to the underworld and back.
tmdb_overview: The tragic love of Orpheus and Eurydice is intertwined with the complex relationship of Hades and Persephone. Eurydice, struggling with poverty, is lured to the industrial underworld of Hadestown by Hades, while Orpheus, a struggling musician, ventures down below to bring her back.

Surrounded by greed, suspicion, and danger, Samuel must risk everything to reunite with his child.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

This is 'Part 1' of two in the De Gaulle series.

Winner of 8 Tony Awards including Best Musical and the Grammy Award for Best Musical Theatre Album, HADESTOWN: THE MUSICAL is the genre-defying musical blending modern American folk music with New Orleans-inspired jazz to reimagine a sweeping ancient tale of two intertwining love stories: that of young dreamers Orpheus and Eurydice, and King Hades and his wife Persephone. 

Filmed live on stage in London’s West End and featuring the original Broadway stars, HADESTOWN: THE MUSICAL invites audiences on a hell-raising journey to the underworld and back.
tmdb_overview: The tragic love of Orpheus and Eurydice is intertwined with the complex relationship of Hades and Persephone. Eurydice, struggling with poverty, is lured to the industrial underworld of Hadestown by Hades, while Orpheus, a struggling musician, ventures down below to bring her back.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis:
Start your night right with a complimentary cocktail reception at 6PM. 
In collaboration with The Natural Philosopher.

Everyman is proud to host Steven Soderbergh's A Man Under The Influence.

The series presents one film from each decade selected by Steven Soderbergh as a source of inspiration throughout his career. 

This week it's the 1990's; join us at Everyman at The Whiteley for Fargo (1996) - A pregnant police chief is investigating a series of homicides across the frozen tundra. Against a sprawling Minnesota landscape, a car salesman hires two criminals to kidnap his wife. But when the scheme goes sour, and wood chippers get involved, the haphazard kidnapping plot turns deadly serious.

Each screening is complete with a 63-minute reception featuring Singani 63 cocktails created with some of London's leading bars and inspired by the night's film, alongside a playlist curated by the filmmaker himself, and an exclusive recorded introduction from Soderbergh.
tmdb_overview: Jerry Lundegaard is a small-town Minnesota car salesman deeply in debt and willing to do almost anything to get out. Police chief Marge Gunderson discovers a string of violent crimes as Jerry's schemes spiral out of control.

movie_title: Toddler Club: We're Going on a Bear Hunt + The Tiger Who Came to Tea
movie_title_en: Toddler Club: We're Going on a Bear Hunt + The Tiger Who Came to Tea
synopsis:
Join us for a delightful double bill from Lupus Films as two beloved childhood classics come to life on the big screen. Perfect for little ones and nostalgic grown-ups alike, enjoy back-to-back screenings of We're Going on a Bear Hunt and The Tiger Who Came to Tea.

WE'RE GOING ON A BEAR HUNT
Follow the intrepid adventures of siblings Stan, Katie, Rosie, Max, the baby and Rufus the dog, who set off on an expedition in search of bears, determined to ‘catch a big one’.

Based on the bestselling bedtime book, written by Michael Rosen and illustrated by Helen Oxenbury, We’re Going on a Bear Hunt is brought to life by the voices of Olivia Colman, Pam Ferris and Mark Williams.

THE TIGER WHO CAME TO TEA
A mysterious tiger turns up unannounced and invites himself in for afternoon tea. Young Sophie and her mummy watch in fascination as the tiger proceeds to eat not only their tea, but the entire contents of the fridge and everything else in the house!

Judith Kerr's beloved story is brought to life by the voices of David Oyelowo, Tamsin Grieg, Benedict Cumberbatch, David Walliams, Paul Whitehouse, and with music from Robbie Williams.

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. From ages 1 to 5, share your childhood favourites and the best new family film releases with your pre-schoolers, and we’ll bring you a warm drink and a slice of cake or a small popcorn, all included in the price of your ticket.

June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

movie_title: Toddler Club: We're Going on a Bear Hunt + The Tiger Who Came to Tea
movie_title_en: Toddler Club: We're Going on a Bear Hunt + The Tiger Who Came to Tea
synopsis:
Join us for a delightful double bill from Lupus Films as two beloved childhood classics come to life on the big screen. Perfect for little ones and nostalgic grown-ups alike, enjoy back-to-back screenings of We're Going on a Bear Hunt and The Tiger Who Came to Tea.

WE'RE GOING ON A BEAR HUNT
Follow the intrepid adventures of siblings Stan, Katie, Rosie, Max, the baby and Rufus the dog, who set off on an expedition in search of bears, determined to ‘catch a big one’.

Based on the bestselling bedtime book, written by Michael Rosen and illustrated by Helen Oxenbury, We’re Going on a Bear Hunt is brought to life by the voices of Olivia Colman, Pam Ferris and Mark Williams.

THE TIGER WHO CAME TO TEA
A mysterious tiger turns up unannounced and invites himself in for afternoon tea. Young Sophie and her mummy watch in fascination as the tiger proceeds to eat not only their tea, but the entire contents of the fridge and everything else in the house!

Judith Kerr's beloved story is brought to life by the voices of David Oyelowo, Tamsin Grieg, Benedict Cumberbatch, David Walliams, Paul Whitehouse, and with music from Robbie Williams.

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. From ages 1 to 5, share your childhood favourites and the best new family film releases with your pre-schoolers, and we’ll bring you a warm drink and a slice of cake or a small popcorn, all included in the price of your ticket.

While celebrating their last night together, Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali, packed with magical and mythological creatures they grew up hearing stories about from their Filipino families. 

Some of these figures will become friends, some foes. Joined by well-meaning-but- hapless weredog Raww (Dave Franco) and a small-but-mighty pack of pals, Jo and Raissa must face The Dreaded Manananggal (Tony winning icon Lea Salonga), the most feared creature on the island. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa will race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

synopsis:
Join us for a delightful double bill from Lupus Films as two beloved childhood classics come to life on the big screen. Perfect for little ones and nostalgic grown-ups alike, enjoy back-to-back screenings of We're Going on a Bear Hunt and The Tiger Who Came to Tea.

WE'RE GOING ON A BEAR HUNT
Follow the intrepid adventures of siblings Stan, Katie, Rosie, Max, the baby and Rufus the dog, who set off on an expedition in search of bears, determined to ‘catch a big one’.

Based on the bestselling bedtime book, written by Michael Rosen and illustrated by Helen Oxenbury, We’re Going on a Bear Hunt is brought to life by the voices of Olivia Colman, Pam Ferris and Mark Williams.

THE TIGER WHO CAME TO TEA
A mysterious tiger turns up unannounced and invites himself in for afternoon tea. Young Sophie and her mummy watch in fascination as the tiger proceeds to eat not only their tea, but the entire contents of the fridge and everything else in the house!

Judith Kerr's beloved story is brought to life by the voices of David Oyelowo, Tamsin Grieg, Benedict Cumberbatch, David Walliams, Paul Whitehouse, and with music from Robbie Williams.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

Michael Mann returns to Everyman Screen on the Green from 25 September to 24 October. Join us for a season dedicated to five unforgettable works from one of modern cinema's most influential filmmakers.

This week, we're screening 'The Last of the Mohicans' in stunning 35mm. Amid the brutal struggle between British and French forces for control of North America's colonies, a romance blossoms between Hawkeye, an adopted frontier settler, and Cora Munro, the daughter of a British colonel. Sweeping, suspenseful and deeply moving, it's an epic tale of love and survival.

synopsis: Two of opera's most extraordinary artists return to The Met: Live in HD for Verdi's thrilling take on the immortal Shakespearean tale of the scheming couple determined to seize power at any cost. Baritone Quinn Kelsey is the Scottish king haunted by the ghosts of his murderous ascent to the throne, opposite soprano Lise Davidsen as the power-mad Lady Macbeth, whose ruinous ambition damns them both. Met Music Director Yannick Nézet-Séguin takes the podium for a penetrating production by Louisa Proske. Rounding out the all-star cast are tenor Freddie De Tommaso as Macduff and bass-baritone Ryan Speedo Green as Banquo.

movie_title: Toddler Club: We're Going on a Bear Hunt + The Tiger Who Came to Tea
movie_title_en: Toddler Club: We're Going on a Bear Hunt + The Tiger Who Came to Tea
synopsis:
Join us for a delightful double bill from Lupus Films as two beloved childhood classics come to life on the big screen. Perfect for little ones and nostalgic grown-ups alike, enjoy back-to-back screenings of We're Going on a Bear Hunt and The Tiger Who Came to Tea.

WE'RE GOING ON A BEAR HUNT
Follow the intrepid adventures of siblings Stan, Katie, Rosie, Max, the baby and Rufus the dog, who set off on an expedition in search of bears, determined to ‘catch a big one’.

Based on the bestselling bedtime book, written by Michael Rosen and illustrated by Helen Oxenbury, We’re Going on a Bear Hunt is brought to life by the voices of Olivia Colman, Pam Ferris and Mark Williams.

THE TIGER WHO CAME TO TEA
A mysterious tiger turns up unannounced and invites himself in for afternoon tea. Young Sophie and her mummy watch in fascination as the tiger proceeds to eat not only their tea, but the entire contents of the fridge and everything else in the house!

Judith Kerr's beloved story is brought to life by the voices of David Oyelowo, Tamsin Grieg, Benedict Cumberbatch, David Walliams, Paul Whitehouse, and with music from Robbie Williams.

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. From ages 1 to 5, share your childhood favourites and the best new family film releases with your pre-schoolers, and we’ll bring you a warm drink and a slice of cake or a small popcorn, all included in the price of your ticket.

While celebrating their last night together, Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali, packed with magical and mythological creatures they grew up hearing stories about from their Filipino families. 

Some of these figures will become friends, some foes. Joined by well-meaning-but- hapless weredog Raww (Dave Franco) and a small-but-mighty pack of pals, Jo and Raissa must face The Dreaded Manananggal (Tony winning icon Lea Salonga), the most feared creature on the island. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa will race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

Judith Kerr's beloved story is brought to life by the voices of David Oyelowo, Tamsin Grieg, Benedict Cumberbatch, David Walliams, Paul Whitehouse, and with music from Robbie Williams.

synopsis:
Winner of 8 Tony Awards including Best Musical and the Grammy Award for Best Musical Theatre Album, HADESTOWN: THE MUSICAL is the genre-defying musical blending modern American folk music with New Orleans-inspired jazz to reimagine a sweeping ancient tale of two intertwining love stories: that of young dreamers Orpheus and Eurydice, and King Hades and his wife Persephone. 

Filmed live on stage in London’s West End and featuring the original Broadway stars, HADESTOWN: THE MUSICAL invites audiences on a hell-raising journey to the underworld and back.
tmdb_overview: The tragic love of Orpheus and Eurydice is intertwined with the complex relationship of Hades and Persephone. Eurydice, struggling with poverty, is lured to the industrial underworld of Hadestown by Hades, while Orpheus, a struggling musician, ventures down below to bring her back.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis:
Michael Mann returns to Everyman Screen on the Green from 25 September to 24 October. Join us for a season dedicated to five unforgettable works from one of modern cinema's most influential filmmakers.

This week, we're screening 'The Last of the Mohicans' in stunning 35mm. Amid the brutal struggle between British and French forces for control of North America's colonies, a romance blossoms between Hawkeye, an adopted frontier settler, and Cora Munro, the daughter of a British colonel. Sweeping, suspenseful and deeply moving, it's an epic tale of love and survival.

Filmed live on stage in London’s West End and featuring the original Broadway stars, HADESTOWN: THE MUSICAL invites audiences on a hell-raising journey to the underworld and back.
tmdb_overview: The tragic love of Orpheus and Eurydice is intertwined with the complex relationship of Hades and Persephone. Eurydice, struggling with poverty, is lured to the industrial underworld of Hadestown by Hades, while Orpheus, a struggling musician, ventures down below to bring her back.

synopsis: Set in 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!

synopsis: Andrew Garfield stars as a legendary leader of a ferocious rebellion against the tyranny of King Richard II. As the war burns across England, he forms an army of the people to face the King’s might in a fight for justice and survival.

synopsis:
From the mind of visionary filmmaker Zach Cregger (Weapons, Barbarian) comes a thrilling — and terrifying — reinvention of the Resident Evil franchise.

In an all-new story, Resident Evil follows Bryan (Austin Abrams), a medical courier who unwittingly finds himself in an action-packed, non-stop race for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

synopsis:
While celebrating their last night together, Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali, packed with magical and mythological creatures they grew up hearing stories about from their Filipino families. 

Some of these figures will become friends, some foes. Joined by well-meaning-but- hapless weredog Raww (Dave Franco) and a small-but-mighty pack of pals, Jo and Raissa must face The Dreaded Manananggal (Tony winning icon Lea Salonga), the most feared creature on the island. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa will race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis:
A landmark in Gothic horror, Dracula cemented Hammer Films' reputation as the leading force in modern horror cinema and introduced audiences worldwide to Christopher Lee's definitive interpretation of Bram Stoker's immortal vampire. 

Opposite Peter Cushing's fearless Van Helsing, Lee brought a terrifying physicality and seductive menace to the role that would redefine the Count for generations. When Jonathan Harker arrives at a remote Transylvanian castle, he discovers that his mysterious host, Count Dracula, is a centuries-old vampire who feeds upon the blood of the living. 

As Dracula's reign of terror spreads across Europe, the determined Professor Van Helsing embarks on a desperate battle to destroy the Prince of Darkness before more innocent lives are claimed.

synopsis:
While celebrating their last night together, Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali, packed with magical and mythological creatures they grew up hearing stories about from their Filipino families. 

Some of these figures will become friends, some foes. Joined by well-meaning-but- hapless weredog Raww (Dave Franco) and a small-but-mighty pack of pals, Jo and Raissa must face The Dreaded Manananggal (Tony winning icon Lea Salonga), the most feared creature on the island. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa will race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

synopsis: Two of opera's most extraordinary artists return to The Met: Live in HD for Verdi's thrilling take on the immortal Shakespearean tale of the scheming couple determined to seize power at any cost. Baritone Quinn Kelsey is the Scottish king haunted by the ghosts of his murderous ascent to the throne, opposite soprano Lise Davidsen as the power-mad Lady Macbeth, whose ruinous ambition damns them both. Met Music Director Yannick Nézet-Séguin takes the podium for a penetrating production by Louisa Proske. Rounding out the all-star cast are tenor Freddie De Tommaso as Macduff and bass-baritone Ryan Speedo Green as Banquo.

Winner of 8 Tony Awards including Best Musical and the Grammy Award for Best Musical Theatre Album, HADESTOWN: THE MUSICAL is the genre-defying musical blending modern American folk music with New Orleans-inspired jazz to reimagine a sweeping ancient tale of two intertwining love stories: that of young dreamers Orpheus and Eurydice, and King Hades and his wife Persephone. 

Filmed live on stage in London’s West End and featuring the original Broadway stars, HADESTOWN: THE MUSICAL invites audiences on a hell-raising journey to the underworld and back.
tmdb_overview: The tragic love of Orpheus and Eurydice is intertwined with the complex relationship of Hades and Persephone. Eurydice, struggling with poverty, is lured to the industrial underworld of Hadestown by Hades, while Orpheus, a struggling musician, ventures down below to bring her back.

June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis:
Michael Mann returns to Everyman Screen on the Green from 25 September to 24 October. Join us for a season dedicated to five unforgettable works from one of modern cinema's most influential filmmakers.

This week, we're screening 'The Last of the Mohicans' in stunning 35mm. Amid the brutal struggle between British and French forces for control of North America's colonies, a romance blossoms between Hawkeye, an adopted frontier settler, and Cora Munro, the daughter of a British colonel. Sweeping, suspenseful and deeply moving, it's an epic tale of love and survival.

In this historical drama, a Nepalese boy grows up with the dream of climbing Mount Everest and becomes a vital part of the British expedition which was the first to reach the mountain's summit in 1953.

synopsis:
While celebrating their last night together, Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali, packed with magical and mythological creatures they grew up hearing stories about from their Filipino families. 

Some of these figures will become friends, some foes. Joined by well-meaning-but- hapless weredog Raww (Dave Franco) and a small-but-mighty pack of pals, Jo and Raissa must face The Dreaded Manananggal (Tony winning icon Lea Salonga), the most feared creature on the island. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa will race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

synopsis: Maria, a primary school teacher doing her best to inspire a class of 10-year-olds, is stifled by one unruly and chaotic student. With her career in question and the child's behaviour spiralling, she makes a series of bad decisions that lead to her accidentally taking and locking this "bad apple" in her home. Maria tries desperately to backtrack, but when the class starts flourishing and the staff and parents are thrilled with the improvement, she finds herself in a very complicated predicament.

synopsis:
Winner of 8 Tony Awards including Best Musical and the Grammy Award for Best Musical Theatre Album, HADESTOWN: THE MUSICAL is the genre-defying musical blending modern American folk music with New Orleans-inspired jazz to reimagine a sweeping ancient tale of two intertwining love stories: that of young dreamers Orpheus and Eurydice, and King Hades and his wife Persephone. 

Filmed live on stage in London’s West End and featuring the original Broadway stars, HADESTOWN: THE MUSICAL invites audiences on a hell-raising journey to the underworld and back.
tmdb_overview: The tragic love of Orpheus and Eurydice is intertwined with the complex relationship of Hades and Persephone. Eurydice, struggling with poverty, is lured to the industrial underworld of Hadestown by Hades, while Orpheus, a struggling musician, ventures down below to bring her back.

June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

This is 'Part 1' of two in the De Gaulle series.

synopsis:

The series presents one film from each decade selected by Steven Soderbergh as a source of inspiration throughout his career. 

This week it's the 2000's; join us at Everyman at The Whiteley for Lost In Translation (2003) - A disenchanted movie star connects with an equally adrift newlywed in a hotel bar in Tokyo. Crossing the language and cultural barriers around them, the two bond deeply over the multidimensional mysteries and marvels of an atmospheric Tokyo, and life itself.

Each screening is complete with a 63-minute reception featuring Singani 63 cocktails created with some of London's leading bars and inspired by the night's film, alongside a playlist curated by the filmmaker himself, and an exclusive recorded introduction from Soderbergh.
tmdb_overview: Two lost souls visiting Tokyo -- the young, neglected wife of a photographer and a washed-up movie star shooting a TV commercial -- find an odd solace and pensive freedom to be real in each other's company, away from their lives in America.

synopsis: A scuba diver who, while looking for his father's remains, is swallowed by an 80-foot, 60-ton sperm whale and has just one hour to get out before his oxygen runs out.
tmdb_overview: Following the death of his father, Jay Gardiner goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay comes to realize that the hard-earned lessons his father imparted may be the key to his escape.

synopsis: Maria, a primary school teacher doing her best to inspire a class of 10-year-olds, is stifled by one unruly and chaotic student. With her career in question and the child's behaviour spiralling, she makes a series of bad decisions that lead to her accidentally taking and locking this "bad apple" in her home. Maria tries desperately to backtrack, but when the class starts flourishing and the staff and parents are thrilled with the improvement, she finds herself in a very complicated predicament.

A landmark in Gothic horror, Dracula cemented Hammer Films' reputation as the leading force in modern horror cinema and introduced audiences worldwide to Christopher Lee's definitive interpretation of Bram Stoker's immortal vampire. 

Opposite Peter Cushing's fearless Van Helsing, Lee brought a terrifying physicality and seductive menace to the role that would redefine the Count for generations. When Jonathan Harker arrives at a remote Transylvanian castle, he discovers that his mysterious host, Count Dracula, is a centuries-old vampire who feeds upon the blood of the living. 

As Dracula's reign of terror spreads across Europe, the determined Professor Van Helsing embarks on a desperate battle to destroy the Prince of Darkness before more innocent lives are claimed.

Faced with a series of deadly family secrets, Lowen struggles to separate fiction from reality, while also blurring the lines with Verity’s husband, Jeremy.

synopsis:
The smash hit Broadway play starring Golden Globe-winner Rose Byrne (If I Had Legs I’d Kick You) and Tony Award winner Kelli O’Hara (The King and I), in cinemas across the US, UK and selected international territories from 22 October 2026.
 
Sparkling, dizzying, and deliciously potent, Fallen Angels, Noël Coward’s champagne-fresh comedy of bad manners, shocked and delighted audiences at its 1925 premiere. Two upper-class wives, their husbands away for the day, share a few toasts to their pre-marital dalliances—with the same man, who just may be en route from France to visit. Old rivalries and past scandals bubble to the surface in this intoxicating romp from one of theatre’s comedy masters.
 
Nominated for 5 Tony Awards® this acclaimed revival of Fallen Angels by the Roundabout Theatre Company was filmed live on stage at Broadway’s Todd Haimes Theatre. Rose Byrne and Kelli O’Hara are joined by Drama Desk Award-winner Tracee Chimo, Emmy Award-winner Mark Consuelos (making his Broadway debut), Tony Award-nominee & Drama Desk Award-winner Christopher Fitzgerald and Obie Award-winner Aasif Mandvi, with critics and theatre fans alike praising the outstanding performances of the ensemble cast.
 
With a beautifully lavish Art Deco set and stunning costumes – which won Jeff Mahshie a Tony Award® for Best Costume Design of a play – this new production was directed by Scott Ellis (Art, Pirates! The Penzance Musical, Take Me Out)

movie_title: Toddler Club: Paw Patrol: The Dino Movie
movie_title_en: Toddler Club: Paw Patrol: The Dino Movie
synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash-land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. From ages 1 to 5, share your childhood favourites and the best new family film releases with your pre-schoolers, and we’ll bring you a warm drink and a slice of cake or a small popcorn, all included in the price of your ticket.

movie_title: Toddler Club: Disney Junior Cinema Club 2026
movie_title_en: Toddler Club: Disney Junior Cinema Club 2026
synopsis:
Packed with fun for preschoolers and their grown-ups, this interactive big-screen experience brings together some favourite Disney Junior stories from Mickey Mouse Clubhouse+, Minnie's Bow-Toons: Pet Hotel, Marvel's Iron Man and His Awesome Friends, Sofia the First: Royal Magic and Toy Story Toons, in a fun-filled extravaganza! Expect sing-alongs, dance moments, exciting games and magical surprises, where audience participation is a must.

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. From ages 1 to 5, share your childhood favourites and the best new family film releases with your pre-schoolers, and we’ll bring you a warm drink and a slice of cake or a small popcorn, all included in the price of your ticket.

Set against the sprawling backdrop of Los Angeles, Heat is a gripping story of obsession, loyalty and sacrifice, featuring some of the most electrifying action sequences ever committed to film.

June 1961, NYC: legendary jazz pianist Bill Evans has found his musical voice and created the perfect trio, including bass player Scott LaFaro, said to be his soulmate through music. A residency at New York’s Village Vanguard culminates in the live taping of two of the greatest jazz records of all time in one night. Ten days later, LaFaro dies in a car crash. Numb with grief, Evans stops playing.

In a contemporary New York City, members of a dysfunctional family of vampires are trying to come to terms with each other, in the wake of their father's death. Meanwhile, they are being hunted by Dr. Van Helsing and his hapless nephew. As in all good vampire movies, forces of love are pitted against forces of destruction.

When a mysterious mist engulfs a futuristic metropolis, unleashing a deadly and elusive entity, a troubled young woman searches for her father. Her quest collides with an American GI on a harrowing odyssey to rescue his daughter from Hell.

As advanced dementia erodes an older woman’s ability to communicate her inner life, her husband and daughter struggle to act in her best interests, navigating love and the fragile boundaries between care, protection and autonomy.

Legendary New York poet Ed Saxberger's forgotten works captivate an eccentric group of young creatives, reigniting his artistic passion. Their intrigue intertwines with the bewitching presence of actress Gloria.

The death of his son causes McElwee, an autobiographical filmmaker, to look back on his life’s work. He eventually turns to his archive of home movies. To what extent did his camera affect their relationship when Adrian was alive? To what extent does it define that relationship now that he is gone? Meanwhile, an effort to adapt McElwee’s first feature, Sherman’s March, into a work of fiction lurches along, giving the filmmaker another perspective from which to meditate on movie making and mortality.

In a cotton-farming village in Sudan, teenage Nafisa is raised on heroic tales of battling British colonizers told by her grandmother, the village matriarch Al-Sit. But when a young businessman arrives from abroad with a new development plan and genetically engineered cotton, Nafisa becomes the center of a power play to determine the future of the village. Awakening to her own strength, Nafisa sets out to save the cotton fields – and herself. Neither she nor her community will ever be the same again.

Awakening to her own strength, Nafisa sets out to save the cotton fields – and herself. Neither she nor her community will ever be the same again.
